# Hostal Restaurante Bellavista Formentera

> A family-run hostal and Mediterranean seafood restaurant on the first line of
> the port of La Savina, Formentera, Balearic Islands, Spain. Open since 1949.

## What it is
- A three-star hostal (guesthouse) with 38 rooms, all with private bathroom.
- Restaurant and bar in the same building, with a large terrace facing the marina.
- Three self-catering apartments elsewhere on the island: Can Loca (Es Pujols),
  Can Peix 22 (La Savina) and Barbaroja (Ca Marí, km 6).
- Legal entity: HOSTAL BELLAVISTA C.B., NIF E57315962.

## Where it is
- Address: Polígon de la Marina 8, 07870 La Savina, Formentera, Illes Balears, Spain.
- Coordinates: 38.7326075, 1.4156931.
- Roughly 200 m from the Ibiza ferry terminal — the island's only port of entry.
- 3 km to Sant Francesc Xavier (the capital), about 5 km to Ses Illetes beach,
  about 6 km to Es Pujols, about 22 km to the La Mola lighthouse.

## Rooms
All three hotel room types sleep two people.
- Economy Room — double bed or twin beds, view onto the inner courtyard.
- Standard Double Room — double bed or twin beds, street view, bathroom with bathtub.
- Port View Room — double bed plus sofa, view over the port of La Savina. The best room.
- Every room: free WiFi, air conditioning, private bathroom, television, wooden desk,
  wardrobe, towels and hairdryer, daily housekeeping.

## Restaurant
- Cuisine: Mediterranean, seafood, traditional Formentera cooking.
- Signature dishes: lobster stew (caldereta de langosta), crab stew, fish zarzuela,
  grilled fish and meat platters, seafood paella, paella Bellavista, arroz a la marinera,
  arroz a banda, fideuà, fresh island fish baked or salt-crusted.

## Booking and contact
- Book direct through the website for the best available rate.
- Phone: +34 971 323 324 and +34 971 322 255.
- Email: reservas@hostal-bellavista.com
- Website: https://themayans.github.io/hostal-bellavista/
- Languages spoken: Spanish, Catalan, English, Italian.
